headers.steps_cons:
(v x : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) :
    steps v (x::xs) = (if v=x then 1 else steps v xs+1)
headers.scan_trace:
(v : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) :
    Trace transition (steps v xs) (.scan v xs) (.halt (contains v xs))
headers.steps_le: (v : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) : steps v xs≤xs.length+1
headers.contains_iff: (v : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) : contains v xs=true ↔ v∈xs
